svg.title: Zava Forward: Azure reference architecture and gated alternatives
svg.desc: Source-realization view of the direct-demo shared API. Core is a presentation frame; conditional device, operations and alternative/resident insets complete the full drawing. PaaS services are outside the VNet. No live inventory, UK inference, compliance or activation is certified.. Read text-equivalent.md for relationships, source locators and acceptance limits.

text.tspan: NSGs + linked private DNS; services are not VNet-hosted
People own consent, technical sign-off, Finance and release. AI returns advice, never case authority.
